name: safaai-sarathi
description: Safaai Sarathi — AI-powered civic waste management platform (citizen reporting, live tracking, hotspot prediction, route optimisation).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend/api install && npm --prefix backend/ai install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.start: concurrently -n AI,API -c magenta,green "npm --prefix backend/ai start" "npm --prefix backend/api start"
